On 2023/05/25 I helped build a comparison table of sustainability/climate reporting frameworks (GRI, SASB, TCFD, IR, EU Taxonomy, SFDR, CSRD) with columns Framework, Regulatory Body, Focus, Applicability, Required Format, and Sources. #esg-reporting #sustainability

CSRD's standardized reporting format is based on the European Single Electronic Format (ESEF), requiring Inline XBRL (iXBRL) tagging of sustainability information in annual reports. #esg-reporting #csrd

NFRD prescribes no particular reporting format: companies report non-financial information in the management report or a separate sustainability report, and the European Commission encourages using GRI, SASB, and TCFD. #esg-reporting #nfrd

NFRD applies to large public-interest entities with more than 500 employees and either a balance sheet total over €20 million or net turnover over €40 million; member states may extend its scope. #esg-reporting #nfrd
CDP's climate disclosure framework is voluntary (not developed or mandated by a regulator), aligned with TCFD, and used alongside GRI, SASB, TCFD, and IR. #esg-reporting #cdp
